$comment: Browser console errors and warnings that do not fail a screen (design 5.4 item 6). Every entry needs a reason; keep the list short. pattern = JavaScript regex on the message text. screens = limit to these screen ids (all when absent). when legacyLeaf = only for cases whose screen declares leaf 'legacy' and expects ok (the page content under the checked layout belongs to a later unit and still runs the legacy data path, which fails without DATABASE_URL). Allowed messages are still written to the case result under console.allowed.

entries.reason: (dash)/error.tsx logs the legacy leaf failure (DATABASE_URL unset by design). The harness separately requires the next log to show 'DATABASE_URL is not set' for that case, so a real API failure is not hidden.
Next dev forwards the same server error of the legacy leaf to the browser console.
React development-build notice (info level in some builds, harmless).
